text:
alex: hey team — accepted the org invite but when I go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference I see 0 repos under 'Your repositories'. 2FA is enabled on my account. anyone know why?

devex-bot: GitHub Invite Event — invite accepted for alex (alex@example.com). Note: SSO is required for some org repos. If you see limited access, please authorize SSO on the organization page.

maria: welcome alex! :) common checklist:
1) confirm the email on your GitHub account matches the invite email (account settings -> Emails)
2) authorize SSO from https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/sso (there should be an "Authorize" button)
3) add your SSH key to your GitHub profile if you want SSH access (Profile -> Settings -> SSH and GPG keys)
4) sometimes team membership and repo perms take a few minutes after onboarding automation runs.

jamal: also try this quick check and paste output:
```
ssh -T git@github.com
```
If it says Permission denied, your ssh key either isn't added or agent isn't forwarding. If it authenticates as your username that's good.

alex: ran ssh -T and got: `Permission denied (publickey)`. i added my key a minute ago though.

jamal: try `ssh-add -l` to see if the key is loaded in your local agent. if you're on mac/linux and using `~/.ssh/id_rsa` or similar: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa` then re-run `ssh -T`.

irene: fyi infra repos are private & SSO enforced. even if ssh works, you need to be in the infra-team to see them. i can check team membership if you post your GH handle.

alex: handle is alex-dev. ran `ssh-add` and now `ssh -T` says: "Hi alex-dev! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access." still seeing only a few public repos, infra repo is 403 when i try to open it.

maria: ok that means SSH auth is fine. next step jamal or @irene can check org-team mapping. sometimes the onboarding bot misses one repo mapping and needs a manual add.

jamal: i'm adding alex-dev to `infra-team` now. give it ~5-10 minutes for GitHub to sync permissions.

alex: thanks — will wait and refresh.

(devex-bot): Onboarding automation: team sync job queued for alex-dev (job id: 89231).

alex: got access to infra repo now, can clone. :thumbsup: thanks everyone!

maria: awesome — welcome aboard! ping #eng-ops if anything else blocks your first-day setup.

jamal: leaving a quick note in the onboarding ticket to double-check the mapping for future hires so this doesn't happen again.
